content:
Starting from iOS 26.4, Apple began supporting conversational apps on CarPlay.

This category includes AI chatbot apps. Siri AI will be added to CarPlay starting with iOS 27. This iPhone system update is currently in beta testing and is expected to officially launch in September.

At the same time, a fourth third-party AI chatbot has begun supporting Apple CarPlay: Meta AI.

The Meta AI iPhone app now supports Apple CarPlay, but with one limitation.

The latest version of the Meta AI iPhone app is now available on CarPlay.

The Meta AI app joins three other third-party chatbot apps already available on CarPlay: ChatGPT, Perplexity, and Grok.

However, it appears that Meta AI on CarPlay is still in a limited testing phase.

Although the iPhone app will appear on CarPlay, opening it may currently display a "not supported" message.

When I tested it, opening the CarPlay app displayed the message: "Your account currently does not support the Meta AI experience."

I tried using a paid Meta AI account to see if the CarPlay feature requires a paid account. However, the message within the Meta AI CarPlay app did not change. Your experience may vary.

Regardless, before Siri AI is officially rolled out to everyone, it is indeed encouraging to see a fourth mainstream chatbot app land on CarPlay.

This is precisely CarPlay's greatest advantage: integrating your existing iPhone apps into your car. This wealth of choice is unmatched by factory-installed infotainment systems.

Earlier this month, Meta AI also landed on Mac. The desktop version is much more powerful than the iPhone and iPad versions.
